title: Large batched Commit can exceed 64 KiB envelope limit
description: Appendix C sets a firm 65536-byte envelope limit (§11.4, §10.3.1), but a Commit with many Add proposals (or a Welcome-heavy batch) can exceed it. Define: committers MUST split membership changes across Commits so each envelope fits, or define an external-blob mechanism for oversized handshake messages. Found in cleanup 2026-10-17.
close_reason: Rule added to spec §5.2.1 (split Commits to fit the envelope limit)
